Home / Learn / Maths Path / Class 1

Maths Path · Ages 5 to 6

Class 1 maths

Numbers to 100, adding, shapes, time and money. Go in order. Pass each check to open the next chapter.

0 of 8 passed

Class 1 chapters in order

  1. 1

    Tens, ones and number names

    Build any number up to 100 from tens and ones.

    • I can build a number with tens and ones.
    • I can match a number to its name.
    • I can compare and order two-digit numbers.
    Not started
  2. 2

    Add, subtract and find the missing part

    Join groups, take some away and find a part that is hiding.

    • I can solve an add or take-away story.
    • I can find a missing part.
    • I can check related number facts.
    Not started
  3. 3

    Picture and number patterns

    Spot what repeats and what comes next.

    • I can fill a missing picture.
    • I can continue a growing pattern.
    • I can find a missing number or letter.
    Not started
  4. 4

    Shapes and solid objects

    Name flat shapes and solid things and say what they can do.

    • I can count shapes and corners.
    • I can choose a solid by what it does.
    • I can complete a simple mirror picture.
    Not started
  5. 5

    Measure length and weight

    Compare fairly and measure with equal units.

    • I can measure with equal units.
    • I can compare weights.
    • I can choose a sensible unit.
    Not started
  6. 6

    Read clocks and calendars

    Read the hands, then talk about days and months.

    • I can read a clock.
    • I can find a later time.
    • I can find a day or month.
    Not started
  7. 7

    Coins, prices and change

    Count coins and notes and work out what you need.

    • I can add coin values.
    • I can total two prices.
    • I can work out my change.
    Not started
  8. 8

    Sort, order and solve picture clues

    Use every clue to sort, order and decide.

    • I can find what does not belong.
    • I can find someone's place in a row.
    • I can follow a picture change or route.
    Not started

Olympiad-style paper
